title: Complete the primary Scene Review checkpoint
description: Expose the complete Scene Review checkpoint through trusted main-process revisions, safe media previews, and truthful renderer-side automatic handoff.
businessContext: The current primary Scene Review only approves assets and retries scenes; V1 also requires prompt, direction, scene type, replacement, removal, preview, and voice-status controls without raw IPC errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary Scene Review shows real safe scene asset previews, narration, duration, scene type, prompt, voice segment status, and asset status.
Primary Scene Review exposes approve, regenerate, prompt edit, direction edit, scene type change, replacement upload, and remove actions.
Scene edits persist immutable stage artifacts and invalidate only the edited scene's media plus affected timing, preview, and export outputs.
Renderer-side Semi-automatic execution never submits the CapCut confirmation string automatically.
Packaging export copies the approved preview MP4 into an explicit workspace-relative final export and keeps the manifest reviewable.
Required V1 documentation is present and records reused services, runtime evidence, blockers, and deferred work.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/domain/test/ipcSchemas.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/semiAutomaticWorkflow.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/packagingExportService.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: Selective scene revision cannot be persisted with the existing artifact store.
